title: Benchmark execution configuration
description: Execution parameters consumed by `load_benchmark_config` (`BenchmarkConfig`): repetitions, early-stopping patience, CPU/GPU split threshold and console layout (DP11-5).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

repetitions.description: Independent runs per (algorithm, instance) pair; one seed offset per repetition.

patience.description: Generations without improvement before early stopping; `null` uses the adaptive formula `2 * sqrt(n)`.

cpu_size_threshold.description: Instances up to this dimension may run the pure CPU baseline.

skip_cpu_default.description: Skip the CPU baseline by default when the instance exceeds `cpu_size_threshold`.

incremental_runs.description: Resume from existing checkpoints instead of restarting every pair.
